guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent:
The Dockerfile build step fails when trying to install python3.11 and related packages. The error messages are: "E: Unable to locate package python3.11", "E: Couldn't find any package by glob 'python3.11'", "E: Unable to locate package python3.11-venv", and "E: Unable to locate package python3.11-distutils". This indicates that the default Ubuntu 20.04 package repositories do not have Python 3.11 available. To fix this, you should add the deadsnakes PPA repository before installing python3.11 and its packages. For example, add these commands before the apt-get install step:

```
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y software-properties-common && \
    add-apt-repository ppa:deadsnakes/ppa && \
    apt-get update
```

Then, proceed with installing python3.11 and related packages. This is necessary because Ubuntu 20.04 ships with older Python versions by default and python3.11 is not included in its main repos. This fix will allow the Dockerfile to build successfully.
